title: Regular points and the boundary-value problem for a hypoelliptic process in a general smooth domain
summary: We fully describe the set of regular and irregular boundary points for a general hypoelliptic stochastic process $(X(t))_{t\geq0}$ absorbed outside a $C^{3,\,1}$ domain $Ω$. The well-posedness of the associated boundary-value problem on $Ω$ is also established in the classical sense. Let us emphasize that, throughout this work, no assumption is made regarding the inherent structure of the boundary of $Ω$.
